DatePrecision.description:
Precision supported by the source text for a date field; null when the date is null.
DAY: day, month and year explicitly stated.
MONTH: month and year explicitly stated.
YEAR: only the year explicitly stated.
DatePrecision.title: DatePrecision

LabInterpretation.description:
Interpretation flag aligned to HL7 v3 ObservationInterpretation
(http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ObservationInterpretation).
Shared by the instrument, clinician and LLM interpretation fields; provenance differs.
LOW: below the reference range.
NORMAL: within the reference range.
HIGH: above the reference range.
CRITICAL_LOW: below the critical low limit.
CRITICAL_HIGH: above the critical high limit.
ABNORMAL: abnormal without a stated direction.
NOT_INTERPRETED: no interpretation available.
LabInterpretation.title: LabInterpretation

LabTrend.description:
Clinician-documented trajectory of a laboratory result, as stated or clearly
implied in the narrative. Never computed from serial values.
IMPROVING: moving toward normal.
WORSENING: moving away from normal.
STABLE: unchanged.
NORMALIZING: returned to or approaching the reference range.
FLUCTUATING: rising and falling without a direction.
NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: None of the above.
LabTrend.title: LabTrend

LabValueType.description:
Representation of the reported laboratory value.
ABSOLUTE: a numeric quantity or concentration.
PERCENT: explicitly reported as a percentage.
NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: representation not determinable from the source.
LabValueType.title: LabValueType

LaboratoryResultMention.description:
One documented laboratory result. Value, unit, trend and the three interpretation
fields come from LabBaseMention. A qualitative result keeps value_numeric null.

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

value_numeric.description: Numeric value of the result as reported in the source. Capture the point estimate only; do not infer values from ranges or qualitative statements.
value_numeric.title: Value Numeric

value_type.description: Representation of the reported value. Use ABSOLUTE when the result is reported as a numeric quantity or concentration. Use PERCENT only when the result is explicitly reported as a percentage or with the '%' symbol (e.g., neutrophils 62%, eosinophils 4%).

value_unit.description: Unit of measurement verbatim from the source (e.g., 'g/dL', 'ng/mL', 'mg/L', 'ug/g', 'fL', 'x10^9/L'). Do not normalize.
value_unit.title: Value Unit

trend.description: Physician-documented directional trajectory of this result as stated or clearly implied in clinical narrative. Capture only explicit clinician assertions about change over time (e.g., 'hemoglobin improving', 'CRP continues to rise'). Do not infer trend from serial numeric values alone.

interp_instrument.description: Structured interpretation flag as printed on the lab report or generated by the lab instrument. Capture only when an explicit flag appears in the structured result header or result table; do not infer from the numeric value alone. Choose exactly one. LOW: flagged 'L' or 'Low'. NORMAL: flagged 'N' or 'Normal', or explicitly marked within range. HIGH: flagged 'H' or 'High'. CRITICAL_LOW: flagged 'LL', 'Critical Low' or a panic-low flag. CRITICAL_HIGH: flagged 'HH', 'Critical High' or a panic-high flag. ABNORMAL: flagged 'A' or 'Abnormal' with no direction. NOT_INTERPRETED: no flag is printed for this result.

interp_clinician.description: Clinician's qualitative assessment of the result as stated in the clinical narrative. Capture only explicit clinician assertions; do not infer from the numeric value alone. Choose exactly one. LOW: stated as low, decreased or below range (e.g., 'hemoglobin is low'). NORMAL: stated as normal or within normal limits (e.g., 'potassium within normal limits'). HIGH: stated as high, elevated or above range (e.g., 'CRP markedly elevated'). CRITICAL_LOW: stated as critically, dangerously or severely low. CRITICAL_HIGH: stated as critically, dangerously or severely high. ABNORMAL: stated as abnormal with no direction. NOT_INTERPRETED: the narrative reports the value without assessing it.

interp_llm.description: LLM best assertion of the result interpretation, synthesized from all available context: numeric value, unit, stated reference range, patient age, clinical narrative, and any implicit cues in the document. Apply general pediatric reference ranges when no explicit range is provided. This field may be populated even when interp_instrument and interp_clinician are absent. Choose exactly one. LOW: below the applicable reference range. NORMAL: within the applicable reference range. HIGH: above the applicable reference range. CRITICAL_LOW: below a critical low limit stated in the document or generally accepted for the analyte. CRITICAL_HIGH: above a critical high limit stated in the document or generally accepted for the analyte. ABNORMAL: abnormal but the direction cannot be determined (e.g., a qualitative result). NOT_INTERPRETED: only when insufficient context exists to make any reasonable determination.

test.description: Which study-specific test this result is. Only tests in LaboratoryTest are extracted; omit results for any other test.

reference_range.description: Documented normal range or upper limit of normal, including age context.
reference_range.title: Reference Range

collection_date.description: Specimen/measurement date, ISO date at supported precision.
collection_date.title: Collection Date

collection_date_precision.description: Precision for collection_date; null if absent.

LaboratoryResultMention.title: LaboratoryResultMention

LaboratoryTest.description:
Study-specific laboratory test. Closed list: a result for any test not listed
here is not extracted at all (no mention is produced for it).
ABSOLUTE_NEUTROPHIL_COUNT: absolute neutrophil count (ANC).
PLATELET_COUNT: platelet count.
HEMOGLOBIN: hemoglobin.
CREATININE_CLEARANCE: creatinine clearance.
MEASURED_GFR: measured glomerular filtration rate.
SERUM_CREATININE: serum creatinine.
TOTAL_BILIRUBIN: total bilirubin.
AST: aspartate aminotransferase.
ALT: alanine aminotransferase.
METHOTREXATE_LEVEL: methotrexate level.
LaboratoryTest.title: LaboratoryTest

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

toxicity.description: Documented adverse event; do not infer toxicity from a lab without clinical interpretation.
toxicity.title: Toxicity

grade.description: Explicit CTCAE grade; never infer from a value alone.
grade.title: Grade

grading_system.description: Named grading system/version if stated; do not assume CTCAE v4 because the paper used it.
grading_system.title: Grading System

event_date.description: Documented toxicity date, ISO date at supported precision.
event_date.title: Event Date

event_date_precision.description: Precision for event_date; null if absent.

attribution.description: Clinician-attributed relationship to treatment, including treatment-related death only if explicitly stated.
attribution.title: Attribution

TreatmentPhase.description:
Treatment phase as documented.
INDUCTION: induction.
CONSOLIDATION: consolidation.
POST_CONSOLIDATION: post-consolidation.
SALVAGE: salvage.
NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: another documented phase, or phase not documented.
TreatmentPhase.title: TreatmentPhase

results.description: Results for the study-specific tests in LaboratoryTest only. Do not include a result for any other laboratory test; leave the list empty if none of the listed tests are documented.
results.title: Results
